```{r}
#Load elephant data 
elephant <- read.csv("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/elephant_2010-Feb2020.csv")

head(elephant)
str(elephant)

coord_x <- "Lon"
coord_y <- "Lat"

target_crs <- "EPSG:4326" 
my_extent <-ext(18.461667, 25.283338, -20.916664, -17.133330)

#Build elephant points 
elephant_pts <- vect(elephant, geom = c(coord_x, coord_y), crs = "EPSG:4326")
elephant_pts <- project(elephant_pts, target_crs)
```
```{r}
#Run multicollinearity test for one season 

run_multicollinearity <- function(raster_folder, season_label) {

  message("Processing season: ", season_label)

  raster_files <- list.files(raster_folder, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  print(raster_files)

  raster_list <- lapply(raster_files, rast)
  names(raster_list) <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(raster_files))

  # Reproject/crop
  raster_list <- lapply(raster_list, function(r) {
    if (crs(r) != crs(target_crs)) {
      r <- project(r, target_crs)
    }
    crop(r, my_extent)
  })

  # Align to first raster as template
  template <- raster_list[[1]]
  raster_list_aligned <- lapply(raster_list, function(r) {
    if (!compareGeom(r, template, stopOnError = FALSE)) {
      r <- resample(r, template, method = "bilinear")
    }
    r
  })

  covariates <- rast(raster_list_aligned)

  layer_names <- unlist(mapply(function(r, nm) {
    if (nlyr(r) == 1) {
      nm
    } else {
      paste0(nm, "_", 1:nlyr(r))
    }
  }, raster_list_aligned, names(raster_list_aligned), SIMPLIFY = FALSE))
  names(covariates) <- layer_names

  print(covariates)

  # Extract covariate values at elephant points
  elephant_vals <- terra::extract(covariates, elephant_pts)
  elephant_vals <- elephant_vals[, -1]
  elephant_vals <- na.omit(elephant_vals)

  # Multicollinearity test
  corrplot(cor(elephant_vals), method = "number", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.7,
            title = paste("Correlation -", season_label), mar = c(0,0,1,0))

  vif_result <- vifstep(elephant_vals, th = 10)
  print(vif_result)

  final_vars <- vif_result@results$Variables
  print(final_vars)

  # Return everything useful, in case you want to inspect later
  list(
    covariates   = covariates,
    elephant_vals = elephant_vals,
    vif_result   = vif_result,
    final_vars   = final_vars
  )
}
```


```{r}
# Run for each season 
dry_folder <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/baseline_2020_with_spei/dry_szn"
wet_folder <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc/data/baseline_2020_with_spei/wet_szn"

dry_results <- run_multicollinearity(dry_folder, "Dry Season")
wet_results <- run_multicollinearity(wet_folder, "Wet Season")

# Access results separately, e.g.:
dry_results$final_vars
wet_results$final_vars
```
